title: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A clear, golden pot for sick days and snow days.
imageAlt: Chicken noodle soup with carrots and celery in a floral bowl
ingredients: 1½ pounds bone-in chicken thighs, skin removed

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Dice 1 onion, slice 3 carrots and 3 celery stalks, and mince 2 garlic cloves. Heat the oil in a soup pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrots, and celery until tender, about 8 minutes. Stir in the garlic.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add 8 cups chicken stock, 1½ pounds chicken thighs, 2 thyme sprigs, and 1 bay leaf. Bring to a boil, then simmer until the thighs reach 165°F and the meat pulls apart easily, about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Lift out the chicken thighs, shred the meat, and discard the bones, thyme, and bay.

steps.title: Add the noodles
steps.text: Boil 6 ounces egg noodles in the broth until tender. Return the shredded meat, stir in the parsley, and season with salt and black pepper to taste.

notes.Notes: The noodles drink up broth as they sit. Cook them separately if you plan on leftovers.
